# LayoutCanvas

## Summary

The BlogPost article canvas: named slots (featuredImage / headline / cardDescription / categories / byline / body / authorBios) arranged by a persisted `Layout` (rows of slots), with drag-to-reorder in edit contexts. Container-query responsive (`@container layout`) so the article adapts to the card's own width.

## Import

```js
import { LayoutCanvas, type Layout } from '../components/layout-canvas';
```
